findings.title: Retry retries a possibly non-idempotent request
findings.detail: Retry retries every failure the same way, including one where send may have already taken effect before returning an error; the brief leaves open whether that is safe.
findings.risk_rationale: Retrying a request that already succeeded server-side can duplicate its effect.

summary: Whether it is safe to retry a non-idempotent request is a brief-level decision, not this patch's to make.
